title: Rotate Matrix 90°
description:
Write a function `rotate_matrix(matrix)` that rotates an n×n matrix 90 degrees clockwise **in-place**.

Example:
```
[[1, 2],    [[3, 1],
 [3, 4]] →   [4, 2]]
```

The function should modify the matrix in place and also return it.
hint: Two-step approach: first transpose (swap across diagonal), then reverse each row.
outputExplanation: Transposing swaps rows and columns, then reversing each row completes the 90° clockwise rotation.
